info.title: Wink API
info.description:
Welcome to the Wink API — a programmer-friendly way to manage, sell and book travel
inventory on the Wink platform. See the **Overview** page (under **API**) for the full
introduction, intended audience, testing, and versioning.
# Extranet API
Endpoints for property owners and operators: register a property, manage facilities and
experiences, set up monetization (rate plans, promotions, cancellation policies), distribute
inventory across sales channels, and reconcile bookings.

tags.name: Lifestyle
tags.description: Manage property lifestyles using this endpoint.

tags.name: Daily Rate
tags.description: Manage daily rates, availability, and occupancy restrictions for master rates. Operations support bulk updates by date range, per-day updates via keyed lists, and paginated queries.

tags.name: Scheduler
tags.description: Manage reservation schedules and calendar items for travel inventory such as meeting rooms, restaurants, spas, activities, attractions, and places. Enables creating, reading, updating, and deleting scheduled events with support for recurring events, timezone handling, and attendee management.

tags.name: Sales Channel
tags.description: Sales Channels are direct relationships between property and affiliate. Account relationships are initiated by either affiliate or hotel and allows for hotels to give sales channel specific pricing to affiliates on an individual basis.

tags.name: Promotion
tags.description: Create, read, update, and delete promotions (discounts and premiums) with complex qualification rules. Promotions can reduce or increase rates based on guest location, booking lead time, length of stay, promo codes, and many other criteria.

tags.name: Cancellation Policy
tags.description: Manage property cancellation policies. Cancellation policies dictate when and if a traveler is entitled to a full / partial / no refund.

tags.name: General Manager
tags.description: Manage the general manager profile for your property.

tags.name: Daily Rate
tags.description: Manage daily rates and availability for your master rates using these endpoints.

tags.name: Promotion Bundle
tags.description: Manage bundles of related promotions. Bundle multiple promotions together to apply coordinated discounts or to simplify offerDetails presentation to guests.

tags.name: Rate Plan
tags.description: Manage rate plans that control inventory availability and pricing terms. Rate plans restrict which combinations of master rates, packages, and add-ons can be sold to guests, allowing fine-grained revenue management by date, occupancy, length of stay, and more.

tags.name: Guest Room
tags.description: Manage property room types.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Retrieve and analyze booking metrics, including property performance, affiliate overview, revenue trends, and detailed time-series analytics.

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: This is the endpoint you will want to work first with to begin the process of adding your properties onto the wink.travel platform.

tags.name: Social Network
tags.description: Manage which social networks the property is connected to.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: Activities are things travelers can do in and around the property. They can be free, for informational purposes only, or they can be bookable and commissionable. The goal of any property is to create as many sellable activities and become more attractive to potential guests by being able to offer more than their competition.

tags.name: Place
tags.description: Places are points of interest travelers visit in and around the property. They can be free, for informational purposes only, or they can be bookable and commissionable. The goal of any property is to create as many sellable places and become more attractive to potential guests by being able to offer more than their competition.

tags.name: Geo-Location
tags.description: Manage property geo-location.

tags.name: Add-On
tags.description: Add-ons are ancillary inventorythat can be added onto a room booking. It can be literally anything; from a tangible to an intangible good. Note that an add-on can also be made mandatory such as an extra water plane ride to your final island destination in the Maldives or an obligatory Christmas dinner.

tags.name: Sales Channel Request
tags.description: Account relationships are initiated by either affiliate or hotel and allows for hotels to give sales channel specific pricing to affiliates on an individual basis.

tags.name: Test Booking
tags.description: Booking endpoints allow you to create and cancel bookings as well as to retrieve all bookings.

tags.name: Recognition
tags.description: A property can associate multiple types of third-party online / offline acknowledgements to their profile in the form of awards, reviews / ratings, articles and more.

tags.name: Booking
tags.description: Booking endpoints allow you to create and cancel bookings as well as to retrieve all bookings.

tags.name: Property
tags.description: Manage your properties

tags.name: Inventory Usage
tags.description: Endpoints for determining if a a sales channel is currently using the specific inventory.

tags.name: Affiliate
tags.description: Browse affiliates with their sales metrics and invite new affiliate partners.

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Generate and export your booking data as a CSV file.

tags.name: Announcement
tags.description: Properties can create date-based announcements for travelers. These announcements are returned in HotelInventoryResponse if the itinerary matches the announcement date.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Inventory API allows you to control which inventory you want to make available at the sales channel level.

tags.name: Calendar Sync
tags.description: CalDAV integration endpoints that enable properties to sync their bookings with external calendar applications (iCal-compatible clients like Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, etc.). Generate and manage secure CalDAV feed URLs and authentication keys.

tags.name: Policy
tags.description: Manage property policy such as whether the property allows children and pets.

tags.name: Welcome Text
tags.description: Generate, refine and save your property's welcome description.

tags.name: Meeting Room
tags.description: Manage meeting rooms that are on and off the premises. Make them viewable-only or let travelers book a meeting room together with their room.

tags.name: Review
tags.description: Travelers can leave reviews after a booking has taken place. Properties can see these reviews and also respond to them.

tags.name: Restaurant
tags.description: Restaurants are eating establishments travelers can go to to get a meal in and around the property. They can be free, for informational purposes only, or they can be bookable and commissionable. The goal of any property is to create as many bookable restaurants and become more attractive to potential guests by being able to offer more than their competition.

tags.name: Master Rate
tags.description:
Master Rates are room types + rules and restrictions that get sold to and booked by travelers. A master rate consists simply of a guest room and a rate plan with the added ability to give away perks to travelers to incentivize them to book this master rate. 

Note: The inventory works with rate plan-level availability. This means you assign the master rate availability and not the room type. You set initial availability on the room type / guest room, but you can override on the master rate level. This gives you more flexibility in how you want to sell your rooms. I.e. you can give more availability to a master rate than another with the same room but different rate plan. You can also overbook that room type.

tags.name: Attraction
tags.description: Attractions are things travelers visit in and around the property. They can be free, for informational purposes only, or they can be bookable and commissionable. The goal of any property is to create as many sellable attractions and become more attractive to potential guests by being able to offer more than their competition.

tags.name: Channel Manager
tags.description: Indicate which channel manager the property is using. This can be done either during property invite or using this endpoint. If it is not done during the invite phase, the channel manager defaults to `TRAVELIKO` which is the same as no channel manager and rate ownership goes to the inventory.

tags.name: Spa
tags.description: Spas are health establishments travelers can go to to get a massage or similar in and around the property. They can be free, for informational purposes only, or they can be bookable and commissionable. The goal of any property is to create as many bookable spas and become more attractive to potential guests by being able to offer more than their competition.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Manage property media including images and videos. Property media are for general pictures of the hotel such as main featured image, around premises, lobby etc. For all other media, each travel inventorysection contains its own section for managing media.

name.description: A descriptive name for this rate plan, such as 'Best Available Rate', 'Non-Refundable', or 'Corporate Rate'.

prepaid.description: When true, indicates if the rate is a prepaid rate.

enabled.description: Whether rate plan is active or not.

breakfast.description: When true, indicates breakfast is included.

brunch.description: When true, indicates brunch is included.

lunch.description: When true, indicates lunch is included.

dinner.description: When true, indicates dinner is included.

sellStartDate.description: The date on which this rate plan becomes available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range. Leave null for no start restriction.

sellEndDate.description: The date on which this rate plan is no longer available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range. Leave null for no end restriction.

stayStartDate.description: The earliest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range. Leave null for no start restriction.

stayEndDate.description: The latest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range. Leave null for no end restriction.

loyaltyPointsAccrue.description: When true, guests earn loyalty points toward the property's loyalty program with this rate plan. When false, this rate plan does not accrue points.

maxAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Maximum number of days in advance a guest may book this rate plan. For example, 180 allows bookings up to 6 months ahead. Leave null for no maximum advance booking window.

minAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Minimum number of days in advance a guest must book this rate plan. For example, 3 requires booking at least 3 days before arrival. Leave null for no minimum advance booking requirement.

minTotalOccupancy.description: Minimum number of guests required to qualify for this rate plan. Leave null for no minimum occupancy requirement.

maxTotalOccupancy.description: Maximum number of guests allowed under this rate plan. Leave null for no maximum occupancy limit.

minLOS.description: Minimum consecutive nights required for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 2 requires a minimum 2-night stay. Leave null for no minimum stay requirement.

maxLOS.description: Maximum consecutive nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 30 caps bookings at 30 nights. Leave null for no maximum stay limit.

minAge.description: Minimum guest age required to book this rate plan, typically used for senior discounts or adult-only rates. Leave null for no minimum age requirement.

maxAge.description: Maximum guest age allowed for this rate plan, typically used for family or age-restricted rates. Leave null for no maximum age restriction.

ratePlanLevelFees.description: Additional fees applied to this rate plan, such as resort facilities fees, parking fees, or cleaning charges. Fees can be charged per day, per stay, per person, or combinations thereof.

availableDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week when this rate plan is available for booking. If null, the rate plan is available on all days.

arrivalDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check in. If null, arrivals are permitted on any day.

departureDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check out. If null, departures are permitted on any day.

requiredDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which at least one night must fall within the stay. Useful for rates requiring weekend stays or specific weekday requirements. If null, no specific day-of-week stay requirements apply.

earlyCheckInCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests checking in early. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no early check-in charge applies.

lateCheckOutCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests staying late after standard checkout time. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no late check-out charge applies.

cancellationPolicyIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the cancellation policy governing refunds and cancellations for this rate plan.

cancellationPolicyExceptions.description: Optional overrides of the cancellation policy for specific date ranges. Allows a property to apply different cancellation terms during peak seasons, events, or special periods. Leave null for no date-specific exceptions.

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied when a single guest books this rate plan. For example, a 10% discount for solo travelers. Leave null for no single occupancy adjustment.

extraPaxRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional adult guest beyond the base occupancy. For example, a per-person surcharge for extra occupants. Leave null for no extra adult adjustment.

extraChildRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional child guest. Typically used for child discounts or family rate adjustments. Leave null for no extra child adjustment.

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation policy details for this exception

startDate.description: Start date for when this cancellation policy should start to override the default cancellation policy.

endDate.description: End date for when this cancellation policy should end overriding the default cancellation policy.

hotelIdentifier.description: Property this cancellation is associated with

refundable.description: Whether this cancellation policy is refundable or not

advanceCancellationFreeOfCharge.description: When the cancellation policy is refundable, this flag can be set and indicates there is more rules involved than just a no-questions-asked refundable.

refundableCancellationCharge.description: If advanceCancellationFreeOfCharge rules is not honored, this property explains what the guest will be charged.

noShowCharge.description: In case the 'Refundable cancellation charge' is set, a different no show charge can be applied.

nonRefundableCancellationCharge.description: When the cancellation policy is non-refundable, this flag can be set and indicates there is more rules involved to calculate what the guest will owe in case of a cancellation.

nonRefundableDeadline.description: The non-refundable charge might can have a deadline. If that deadline passes, the guest might be charged more.

nonRefundableAfterDeadlineCancellationCh.description: If the guest does not honor the non-refundable deadline rule, this charge dictates what she owes after the deadline passes.

sellEndDate.description: The date on which this rate plan is no longer available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range.

stayStartDate.description: The earliest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

stayEndDate.description: The latest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

loyaltyPointsAccrue.description: When true, guests earn loyalty points toward the property's loyalty program with this rate plan. When false, this rate plan does not accrue points.

maxAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Maximum number of days in advance a guest may book this rate plan. For example, 180 allows bookings up to 6 months ahead.

minAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Minimum number of days in advance a guest must book this rate plan. For example, 3 requires booking at least 3 days before arrival.

minTotalOccupancy.description: Minimum number of guests required to qualify for this rate plan.

maxTotalOccupancy.description: Maximum number of guests allowed under this rate plan.

minLOS.description: Minimum consecutive nights required for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 2 requires a minimum 2-night stay.

maxLOS.description: Maximum consecutive nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 30 caps bookings at 30 nights.

minAge.description: Minimum guest age required to book this rate plan, typically used for senior discounts or adult-only rates.

maxAge.description: Maximum guest age allowed for this rate plan, typically used for family or age-restricted rates.

ratePlanLevelFees.description: Additional fees applied to this rate plan, such as resort facilities fees, parking fees, or cleaning charges. Fees can be charged per day, per stay, per person, or combinations thereof.

availableDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week when this rate plan is available for booking. If null, the rate plan is available on all days.

arrivalDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check in. If null, arrivals are permitted on any day.

departureDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check out. If null, departures are permitted on any day.

requiredDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which at least one night must fall within the stay. Useful for rates requiring weekend stays or specific weekday requirements. If null, no specific day-of-week stay requirements apply.

earlyCheckInCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests checking in early. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no early check-in charge applies.

lateCheckOutCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests staying late after standard checkout time. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no late check-out charge applies.

cancellationPolicy.description: The cancellation policy that governs refunds and cancellations for this rate plan.

cancellationPolicyExceptions.description: Optional overrides of the cancellation policy for specific date ranges. Allows a property to apply different cancellation terms during peak seasons, events, or special periods. Leave null for no date-specific exceptions.

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied when a single guest books this rate plan. For example, a 10% discount for solo travelers. If null, no single occupancy adjustment applies.

extraPaxRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional adult guest beyond the base occupancy. For example, a per-person surcharge for extra occupants. If null, no extra adult adjustment applies.

extraChildRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional child guest. Typically used for child discounts or family rate adjustments. If null, no extra child adjustment applies.

type.description: When the type is FIXED, fixedAmount is required. When the type is PERCENTAGE, percent is required.

percent.description: A percentage of the total stay amount for an early check-in or late check-out

bedTypeCode.description: OpenTravel bed type code (e.g., 1=Double, 2=Twin, 7=Queen, 8=King). See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory).

quantity.description: Number of beds of this type in the room.

BedroomConfiguration_SupplierDetails.description: A named bedroom layout configuration for a room type, containing one or more bedrooms each with their own bed setup.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for this bedroom configuration layout.

name.description: Human-readable name of this room layout configuration.

bedroomList.description: List of bedrooms within this configuration layout.

Bedroom_SupplierDetails.description: A single bedroom within a room type, specifying the bedroom type and its bed configuration.

type.description: Bedroom type classification (e.g., MASTER, QUEEN, JUNIOR, DORMITORY, BEDROOM_1...BEDROOM_10).

bedList.description: List of bed configurations for this bedroom. Each entry specifies a bed type and quantity.

BeneficiaryCharge_SupplierDetails.description: Defines how a beneficiary's slice of the booking is calculated: either as a fixed percentage of the total stay price, or as the remainder after other beneficiaries have taken their share.

type.description: PERCENTAGE: apply the percent field to the total booking price. REMAINDER: this beneficiary receives whatever is left after other beneficiaries are satisfied (typically used for the hotel).

percent.description: The percentage value (0.0–1.0) to apply to the total booking amount when type=PERCENTAGE. For example, 0.050 = 5% of the booking price. Ignored when type=REMAINDER.

Beneficiary_SupplierDetails.description: A beneficiary is a registered account entitled to a portion of booking funds. Funds are allocated by type (SALE, COMMISSION, PLATFORM_FEE, etc.) and tracked across source, display, and internal (platform) currencies. Refund modifiers record adjustments from cancellations.

accountIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the beneficiary's account in the TripPay system

accountName.description: Display name of the beneficiary account (e.g. hotel, affiliate, or platform name)

accountEmail.description: Contact email address for the beneficiary account

accountUrl.description: Profile or dashboard URL for the beneficiary account

type.description: Category of the beneficiary: SALE (property), COMMISSION (affiliate), PLATFORM_FEE (Wink), TRIP_PAY (platform internal), or agency fees

amountDue.description: Charge rule: either a fixed percentage of the total stay or the remainder after other beneficiaries are deducted

sourceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the originating source (supplier's local currency, e.g. hotel in Thailand uses THB)

displayCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for display to the user (e.g. booking shown in USD)

internalCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for internal platform ledger (always USD)

sourceAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in source currency (before refunds)

displayAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in display currency (before refunds)

internalAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in internal currency (before refunds)

sourceAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to sourceAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

displayAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to displayAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

internalAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to internalAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

items.description: Pending refunds awaiting settlement. Once a refund transitions from PENDING to APPLIED, it moves out of this list and into the corresponding *AmountRefundModifier property

netSourceAmount.description: Net amount owed in source currency (sourceAmount - sourceAmountRefundModifier)

netDisplayAmount.description: Net amount owed in display currency (displayAmount - displayAmountRefundModifier)

netInternalAmount.description: Net amount owed in internal currency (internalAmount - internalAmountRefundModifier)

reconciled.description: Flag indicating whether net amounts have been transferred (disbursed) from TripPay to the beneficiary

metadata.description: Additional key-value metadata for the beneficiary (e.g. bank details, supplier identifiers)

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation policy details for this exception

startDate.description: Start date for when this cancellation policy should start to override the default cancellation policy.

endDate.description: End date for when this cancellation policy should end overriding the default cancellation policy.

CancellationPolicyExceptions_SupplierDet.description: Container holding the list of date-range exceptions that override the default cancellation policy for a property

CancellationPolicyLightweight_SupplierDe.description: Lightweight view of a cancellation policy containing all refundability rules and charge details, suitable for embedding in other documents

hotelIdentifier.description: Property this cancellation is associated with

refundable.description: Whether this cancellation policy is refundable or not

advanceCancellationFreeOfCharge.description: When the cancellation policy is refundable, this flag can be set and indicates there is more rules involved than just a no-questions-asked refundable.

refundableCancellationCharge.description: If advanceCancellationFreeOfCharge rules is not honored, this property explains what the guest will be charged.

noShowCharge.description: In case the 'Refundable cancellation charge' is set, a different no show charge can be applied.

nonRefundableCancellationCharge.description: When the cancellation policy is non-refundable, this flag can be set and indicates there is more rules involved to calculate what the guest will owe in case of a cancellation.

nonRefundableDeadline.description: The non-refundable charge might can have a deadline. If that deadline passes, the guest might be charged more.

nonRefundableAfterDeadlineCancellationCh.description: If the guest does not honor the non-refundable deadline rule, this charge dictates what she owes after the deadline passes.

rateSource.description: Indicate where this rate originated from. Leave as TRAVELIKO unless you are a channel manager and responsible for the property's rates externally of this platform.

ratePlanIdentifier.description: Rate plan associated with this daily rate.

guestRoomIdentifier.description: Guest room associated with this daily rate.

master.description: This flag indicates whether this rate is available for this date.

closedOnArrival.description: This flag indicates whether a guest can arrive at the property on this date.

closedOnDeparture.description: This flag indicates whether a guest can leave the property on this date.

date.description: The date this rate is applicable for.

quantity.description: Amount of rooms available for this date.

minOccupancy.description: Minimum number of guests allowed in a room type.

maxOccupancy.description: Maximum number of guest allowed in a room type.

minLengthOfStay.description: Control the minimum length of stay at the day-level. This means that a guest arriving within this date range is required to stay at least these number of days in order to get this rate. Leave empty if you don't want to update this property.

maxLengthOfStay.description: Control the maximum length of stay at the day-level. This means that a guest arriving within this date range is required to stay no longer than these number of days in order to get this rate. Leave empty if you don't want to update this property.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for this rate plan.

hotelIdentifier.description: The property (managing entity) that owns this rate plan.

name.description: A descriptive name for this rate plan, such as 'Best Available Rate', 'Non-Refundable', or 'Corporate Rate'.

prepaid.description: When true, indicates if the rate is a prepaid rate.

enabled.description: Whether rate plan is active or not.

breakfast.description: When true, indicates breakfast is included.

brunch.description: When true, indicates brunch is included.

lunch.description: When true, indicates lunch is included.

dinner.description: When true, indicates dinner is included.

sellStartDate.description: The date on which this rate plan becomes available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range.

sellEndDate.description: The date on which this rate plan is no longer available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range.

stayStartDate.description: The earliest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

stayEndDate.description: The latest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

loyaltyPointsAccrue.description: When true, guests earn loyalty points toward the property's loyalty program with this rate plan. When false, this rate plan does not accrue points.

maxAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Maximum number of days in advance a guest may book this rate plan. For example, 180 allows bookings up to 6 months ahead.

minAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Minimum number of days in advance a guest must book this rate plan. For example, 3 requires booking at least 3 days before arrival.

minTotalOccupancy.description: Minimum number of guests required to qualify for this rate plan.

maxTotalOccupancy.description: Maximum number of guests allowed under this rate plan.

minLOS.description: Minimum consecutive nights required for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 2 requires a minimum 2-night stay.

maxLOS.description: Maximum consecutive nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 30 caps bookings at 30 nights.

minAge.description: Minimum guest age required to book this rate plan, typically used for senior discounts or adult-only rates.

maxAge.description: Maximum guest age allowed for this rate plan, typically used for family or age-restricted rates.

ratePlanLevelFees.description: Additional fees applied to this rate plan, such as resort facilities fees, parking fees, or cleaning charges. Fees can be charged per day, per stay, per person, or combinations thereof.

availableDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week when this rate plan is available for booking. If null, the rate plan is available on all days.

arrivalDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check in. If null, arrivals are permitted on any day.

departureDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check out. If null, departures are permitted on any day.

requiredDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which at least one night must fall within the stay. Useful for rates requiring weekend stays or specific weekday requirements. If null, no specific day-of-week stay requirements apply.

earlyCheckInCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests checking in early. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no early check-in charge applies.

lateCheckOutCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests staying late after standard checkout time. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no late check-out charge applies.

cancellationPolicy.description: The cancellation policy that governs refunds and cancellations for this rate plan.

cancellationPolicyExceptions.description: Optional overrides of the cancellation policy for specific date ranges. Allows a property to apply different cancellation terms during peak seasons, events, or special periods. Leave null for no date-specific exceptions.

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied when a single guest books this rate plan. For example, a 10% discount for solo travelers. If null, no single occupancy adjustment applies.

extraPaxRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional adult guest beyond the base occupancy. For example, a per-person surcharge for extra occupants. If null, no extra adult adjustment applies.

extraChildRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional child guest. Typically used for child discounts or family rate adjustments. If null, no extra child adjustment applies.

refundable.description: true to apply only to refundable rates, false to apply only to non-refundable rates.

daysOfWeek.description: The days of the week the user has to stay on to get this rate

numberOfAdvanceDays.description: You can control the initial itinerary date used to retrieve travel inventory prices. You can do it in one of two ways: 1. Dynamically set the date by indicating how long and how many days in advance (this field), of today's date, you want to display prices for. 2. Set a fixed date to display prices for. Option 1 is the most shared. Option 2 is for when you want to create a new customization and apply it to a specific event that occurs on a specific date. If you don't use either of these options, the itinerary will default to today's date with one night stay. ONLY populate this field if you want to control the itinerary date. Also, leave `startDate` and `endDate` empty.

numberOfStayDays.description: You can control the initial itinerary date used to retrieve travel inventory prices. You can do it in one of two ways: 1. Dynamically set the date by indicating how long (this field) and how many days in advance, of today's date, you want to display prices for. 2. Set a fixed date to display prices for. Option 1 is the most shared. Option 2 is for when you want to create a new customization and apply it to a specific event that occurs on a specific date. If you don't use either of these options, the itinerary will default to today's date with one night stay. ONLY populate this field if you want to control the itinerary date. Also, leave `startDate` and `endDate` empty.

startDate.description: Set a fixed itinerary start date. ONLY populate this field if you want to fix the itinerary date. Also, leave `numberOfAdvanceDays` and `numberOfStayDays` empty.

numberOfAdvanceDays.description: You can control the initial itinerary date used to retrieve travel inventory prices. You can do it in one of two ways: 1. Dynamically set the date by indicating how long and how many days in advance (this field), of today's date, you want to display prices for. 2. Set a fixed date to display prices for. Option 1 is the most shared. Option 2 is for when you want to create a new customization and apply it to a specific event that occurs on a specific date. If you don't use either of these options, the itinerary will default to today's date with one night stay. ONLY populate this field if you want to control the itinerary date. Also, leave `startDate` and `endDate` empty.

numberOfStayDays.description: You can control the initial itinerary date used to retrieve travel inventory prices. You can do it in one of two ways: 1. Dynamically set the date by indicating how long (this field) and how many days in advance, of today's date, you want to display prices for. 2. Set a fixed date to display prices for. Option 1 is the most shared. Option 2 is for when you want to create a new customization and apply it to a specific event that occurs on a specific date. If you don't use either of these options, the itinerary will default to today's date with one night stay. ONLY populate this field if you want to control the itinerary date. Also, leave `startDate` and `endDate` empty.

startDate.description: Set a fixed itinerary start date. ONLY populate this field if you want to fix the itinerary date. Also, leave `numberOfAdvanceDays` and `numberOfStayDays` empty.

endDate.description: Set a fixed itinerary end date ONLY populate this field if you want to fix the itinerary date. Also, leave `numberOfAdvanceDays` and `numberOfStayDays` empty.

The array of data items which represent the series data.

You can set it to:

- Array of numbers. Supported when the series.type option is set to `area`, `bar`, `column`, `donut`, `pie`, `line`, or `waterfall`.
The Bubble series need arrays of three values—X value, Y value, and Size value—for example, [1, 1, 10]. The Scatter and ScatterLine series need arrays of two values—X value and Y value. The OHLC and Candlestick series need arrays of four values—open, high, low, and close. The RangeBar and RangeArea series need arrays of two values—the from and to value.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for this rate plan.

brunch.description: When true, indicates brunch is included.

sellStartDate.description: The date on which this rate plan becomes available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range.

sellEndDate.description: The date on which this rate plan is no longer available for booking. If both sellStartDate and sellEndDate are set, the rate can only be sold within that date range.

stayStartDate.description: The earliest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

stayEndDate.description: The latest date a guest can check in to use this rate plan. If both stayStartDate and stayEndDate are set, the rate can only be used for stays within that date range.

loyaltyPointsAccrue.description: When true, guests earn loyalty points toward the property's loyalty program with this rate plan. When false, this rate plan does not accrue points.

maxAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Maximum number of days in advance a guest may book this rate plan. For example, 180 allows bookings up to 6 months ahead.

minAdvanceBookingOffset.description: Minimum number of days in advance a guest must book this rate plan. For example, 3 requires booking at least 3 days before arrival.

minTotalOccupancy.description: Minimum number of guests required to qualify for this rate plan.

maxTotalOccupancy.description: Maximum number of guests allowed under this rate plan.

minLOS.description: Minimum consecutive nights required for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 2 requires a minimum 2-night stay.

maxLOS.description: Maximum consecutive nights allowed for a booking under this rate plan. For example, 30 caps bookings at 30 nights.

minAge.description: Minimum guest age required to book this rate plan, typically used for senior discounts or adult-only rates.

maxAge.description: Maximum guest age allowed for this rate plan, typically used for family or age-restricted rates.

ratePlanLevelFees.description: Additional fees applied to this rate plan, such as resort facilities fees, parking fees, or cleaning charges. Fees can be charged per day, per stay, per person, or combinations thereof.

availableDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week when this rate plan is available for booking. If null, the rate plan is available on all days.

arrivalDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check in. If null, arrivals are permitted on any day.

departureDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which guests are allowed to check out. If null, departures are permitted on any day.

requiredDaysOfWeek.description: Days of the week on which at least one night must fall within the stay. Useful for rates requiring weekend stays or specific weekday requirements. If null, no specific day-of-week stay requirements apply.

earlyCheckInCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests checking in early. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no early check-in charge applies.

lateCheckOutCharge.description: A pricing modifier for guests staying late after standard checkout time. May include a surcharge or credit. If null, no late check-out charge applies.

cancellationPolicy.description: The cancellation policy that governs refunds and cancellations for this rate plan.

cancellationPolicyExceptions.description: Optional overrides of the cancellation policy for specific date ranges. Allows a property to apply different cancellation terms during peak seasons, events, or special periods. Leave null for no date-specific exceptions.

singleOccupancyRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied when a single guest books this rate plan. For example, a 10% discount for solo travelers. If null, no single occupancy adjustment applies.

extraPaxRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional adult guest beyond the base occupancy. For example, a per-person surcharge for extra occupants. If null, no extra adult adjustment applies.

extraChildRateModifier.description: A pricing modifier applied for each additional child guest. Typically used for child discounts or family rate adjustments. If null, no extra child adjustment applies.

roomViewCode.description: Indicates the view of the room. Typical values would be "Ocean view", "Pool view" or "Garden View". Supported OTA specification `RVT` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

composite.description: Indicates that the room (suite) is a composite of smaller units.

compositeCount.description: Number of rooms of this room type that makes up a larger unit (composite) such as a two bedroom suite could be comprised of two king rooms plus other room types. A 0 means disabled.

roomClassificationCode.description: Specifies the room classification (e.g., cabin, apartment). Supported OTA specification `GRI` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

roomArchitectureCode.description: Specifies the architectural style of a room. Supported OTA specification `ARC` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

roomGender.description: Used to request or specify a gender assignment for a room. Note: Typically used by Hosteliers.

sharedRoomInd.description: If TRUE, the room requires or has sharing available. Note: Typically used by Hosteliers.

maxCribs.description: Maximum number of cribs allowed in a room type.

amenities.description: Collection of room amenity items available to the guest. Supported OTA specification `RMA` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

includedAdultOccupancy.description: The number of pax the room price was meant for

includedChildOccupancy.description: The number of children the room price was meant for

baseRate.description: Typical one night rate during regular remand period

minRate.description: Typical one night rate in a distressed period

RemoveEntryResponse.description: Response object for when a system document is removed.

example.message: Property marked as deleted. Can be restored within 30 days.

success.description: Whether the removal was successful or not.

message.description: Message with additional information; mostly if the removal request was a failure.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description:
Every endpoint is protected with OAuth2 **client credentials**. Create an
**Application** in your account to obtain a `clientId` and `clientSecret`, then
exchange them for a short-lived bearer token.

### 1. Request an access token
`POST` to the **Token URL** below with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
and a body of `grant_type=client_credentials` (optionally `scope=<space-separated scopes>`).
Send your credentials as HTTP Basic auth:
`Authorization: Basic base64(clientId + ":" + clientSecret)`.

### 2. Call the API
Pass the returned token on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Tokens carry only the scopes granted to your Application — request the least privilege
you need. There is no interactive authorize step and no refresh token for this flow;
request a new token when the current one expires.
oauth2ClientCredentials.name: Client Credentials
